purpose: Rules for how Claude Code plugin Python scripts return exit codes and error output so AI callers can branch on failures, covering stdout JSON, stderr, and exit code declarations.
summary: Exit codes 0, 1, 2 have common meaning; 3 and above are defined per script
Completion judgment excludes result content; zero findings still exit 0
Scripts returning 3 or above must declare a full exit code table in the module docstring
Wrapper scripts must declare passthrough ranges or collapse to 0, 1, 2
Callers branch on a value only when the producer declares it
Stdout carries result JSON on 0 and error JSON with an errors array otherwise
Exception for argparse exit 2, which writes usage to stderr only
Stderr diagnostics allowed but error content must also appear in stdout JSON
Existing scripts are not violations; rules apply to newly placed scripts
Harness-defined contracts such as hooks are exempt
tasks: Writing module docstrings declaring exit codes
Writing SKILL.md steps that react to script exit codes
Writing wrapper scripts around other scripts
title: script のエラー出力
